methodology: The ranked list contains only results from the RTX 4070 node above. Historical fields that were not captured in the same run are shown as not recorded instead of being inferred. Community hardware is kept in a separate, unranked dataset. Retired profiles keep their last measured performance in the archive tab; they are no longer reproducible on this node. Qwen3.8 serving metadata was imported from original checkout commit ed7538a; these are source-reported historical measurements, not monorepo acceptance results. Referenced new benchmark harnesses were not committed in that source snapshot and have not been imported. Historical model results may use different hardware settings.

qwen38-flash-next-mtp.summary: PR #28243 on master with compact 1.78 GB shared-Q4_K_M draft head. Offloads 3 MoE layers to GPU (-ncmoe 45), breaking 20 t/s across all tasks: 20.65 t/s aggregate (up to 21.9-22.4 t/s on code/SQL), 77-96% draft acceptance, 11.78 GB VRAM footprint.

qwen38-flash-next.summary: Plain upstream master b11475 (7e8324f5f). 17.34 t/s steady decode, pp 587 t/s @ 8k context (q8_0 KV, --fit on --fit-target 512, ub 2048). Natively includes PR #29761 (native MTP), #29824/5 (indexer memory halved), #29901 (4-head tiling), and #29599 NVMe row prefetching. VRAM reduced to 11.1 GB.

qwen38-flash-next-exp.summary: Experimental tier: master b11475 + PR #29887 (GPU LRU cache for host-offloaded MoE experts, --moe-cache-mib 2048) + PR #28671 (radix-select TOP_K). Breakthrough decode jump to 23.92 t/s (+40.1% over plain offload) within 11,454 MiB VRAM.

qwen38-flash-next-vision.summary: Multimodal vision tier: upstream master b11475 with mmproj-F16.gguf projector. Offloads 3 MoE layers to GPU (-ncmoe 45), 18.2-18.6 t/s @ 32k ctx, 10.8 GB VRAM with 1.3 GB headroom.

qwen3-8-27b-iq3-xxs.summary: Dense 27B hybrid; middle quant tier. Fits the native 262k window in VRAM with q5_0/q4_1 KV at ~36.7 t/s — the long-context + quality play on 12 GB.

qwen38-flash-next-plat.summary: Platinum tier: Strata v0.1.40.2 with online dynamic expert VRAM caching (3,086 hot experts in VRAM), native MTP draft head (Q2_0), 128k context with dynamic KV streaming, native 2 MB Transparent Huge Page (THP) memory acceleration, and #783 kernel perf suite. 56.1 t/s steady decode on code, 90.2 t/s peak burst, pp 953-1,999 t/s.
qwen38-flash-next-plat.cacheState: k8v4 KV; 3,086 hot experts in VRAM; native THP 2MB pages

qwen38-flash-next-plat-vision.summary: Platinum multimodal tier: Strata engine paired with CPU-offloaded strata-vision image encoder (mmproj-F16). Retains 100% of GPU expert cache with zero VRAM loss for vision. 53-60 t/s decode, 128k context.
